# Amazon Bedrock AgentCore - Overview (Fetched 2026-05-18)

## Core Definition
Amazon Bedrock AgentCore is an agentic platform for building, deploying, and operating highly effective agents securely at scale using any framework and foundation model, without infrastructure management.

## Core Services

| Service | Description | Key Integrations |
|---------|-------------|------------------|
| **Runtime** | Secure, serverless runtime for deploying/scaling AI agents and tools. Fast cold starts, async support, session isolation, built-in identity, multi-modal/multi-agent support | CrewAI, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Google ADK, OpenAI Agents SDK, Strands Agents; MCP and A2A protocols |
| **Memory** | Context-aware agents with short-term and long-term memory with cross-agent sharing | LangGraph, LangChain, Strands, LlamaIndex |
| **Gateway** | Converts APIs, Lambda functions, services into MCP-compatible tools | Salesforce, Zoom, JIRA, Slack, any OpenAPI specs |
| **Identity** | Secure agent identity/access/authentication management compatible with existing IdPs | Cognito, Okta, Azure Entra ID, Auth0 |
| **Code Interpreter** | Isolated sandbox for agents to execute code | Python, JavaScript, TypeScript |
| **Browser** | Cloud-based browser runtime for web interactions and form filling | Playwright, BrowserUse |
| **Observability** | Unified tracing, debugging, monitoring via OpenTelemetry | OpenTelemetry, CloudWatch |
| **Payments** (NEW) | Fully managed service enabling microtransaction payments for AI agents to access paid APIs, MCP servers, and content using the x402 protocol. Wallet integration, configurable spending limits, end-to-end observability. | Coinbase CDP, Stripe (Privy), x402-compatible endpoints, AgentCore Gateway, Strands Agents |
| **Evaluations** | Automated agent assessment | LangGraph, Strands, OpenInference, CloudWatch |
| **Policy** | Deterministic control using natural language or Cedar policy language | Cedar policy language, Gateway integration |
| **Registry** | Centralized catalog for agents, MCP servers, tools, skills | Agent Registry |

## Use Cases
1. **Agents** - Autonomous apps for customer support, workflow automation, data analysis, coding assistance
2. **Tools & MCP Servers** - Transform existing APIs/services into agent-accessible tools
3. **Agent Platforms** - Enterprise frameworks with centralized observability and governance

## Supported Frameworks
CrewAI, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Strands Agents, LangChain, Google ADK, OpenAI Agents SDK

## Supported Models
Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, Google Gemini, Amazon Nova, Meta Llama, Mistral

## Protocols
Model Context Protocol (MCP), A2A (Agent-to-Agent), OpenTelemetry (OTEL), OpenInference, x402

## Integrations
Salesforce, Zoom, JIRA, Slack (via Gateway), Coinbase CDP, Stripe (via Payments)

## Pricing
Consumption-based (no upfront commitments or minimum fees)

Updated: 2026-05-18 — NEW since last scan: Payments service (x402 protocol, Coinbase CDP and Stripe/Privy wallet providers, microtransactions for agent access to paid APIs/MCP servers/content).
